overview: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia, between Russia and China. Its capital, Ulaanbaatar, is home to almost half of the population and is the coldest capital city in the world. In the 1200s Genghis Khan founded the Mongol Empire, which became the largest connected land empire in history. Many Mongolians still herd animals and live in traditional round tents called gers.

geography.text: Mongolia is one of the most thinly populated countries in the world. The north and west have mountains, forests and lakes, the centre and east are vast grassy steppes, and the south is the Gobi Desert, where many dinosaur fossils have been found. Winters are long and bitterly cold.
